purpose: Teach: いち早く/連ね/硬直/専任/クーポン/仕上がっ/大々的/各位

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯人の情報、いち早く、つかむことができました、本当に、市民の皆様の、ご協力、ありがたく、思っております、本当に。
lines.en: The police were able to obtain suspect information remarkably quickly. We're truly grateful for all the cooperation from citizens.
lines.style: Professional but warm. Measured cadence with slight emphasis on 「いち早く」. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone delivering good news within a formal frame. Quiet gratitude in the closing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、警察関係者、名を、連ねる、危機対応チーム、立ち上げております、本当に、頼もしいです、ご縁、ありがたく。
lines.en: Yes. We've launched an internal crisis response team with police liaisons on board. It's reassuring, and we're grateful for the partnership.
lines.style: Engaged and collaborative. Upright posture. Nods slightly on 「立ち上げております」 to signal confidence. Warmer than procedural — this is about working together. Sincere on the gratitude.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察組織、硬直化、避けるよう、改革、進めております、本当に、現代に、合わせた、組織、目指しております、最近、特に。
lines.en: We're advancing reforms to prevent police organizations from becoming rigid. We're aiming for a structure that fits modern times, especially recently.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful delivery. Slight pause before 「現代に合わせた」 — thinking aloud without rushing. Professional but reflective. Not defensive; genuinely committed to the point being made.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、警察対応の、専任窓口、設置いたしました、迅速な、連携、可能になっております、本当に、便利、最近、特に。
lines.en: Yes. We've established a dedicated liaison window for police coordination at our company. This allows us to respond swiftly and work together more effectively.
lines.style: Clear and direct. Slight lift on 「設置いたしました」 — a point of pride. Practical tone: this is a concrete step taken. Warm without being effusive.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯講座、クーポン、配布する予定です、市民の皆様、ご活用、いただきたく、お願い、申し上げます、本当に、ご協力を。
lines.en: We're planning to distribute coupons for crime prevention seminars to the public. We'd appreciate it if citizens would take advantage of these opportunities.
lines.style: Formal but approachable. Even pacing. Slight lean forward on 「ご活用いただきたく」 — genuinely inviting participation, not just announcing. Respectful without distance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。報告書、ようやく、仕上がってまいりました、警察様に、提出させていただきます、本当に、ありがとうございました、お世話に。
lines.en: Yes. Our report has finally been completed. We'll be submitting it to the police. We're truly grateful for all your support.
lines.style: Relieved and appreciative. Soft emphasis on 「ようやく」 — the weight of waiting lifts. Respectful bow in the voice at the close. Genuine thanks, not ceremonial.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯キャンペーン、大々的に、展開させていただいております、本当に、企業様の、ご協力、ありがたく、感謝しております、いつも。
lines.en: We're rolling out a major crime prevention campaign. We're truly thankful for the cooperation from companies like yours. Your support means everything.
lines.style: Warm and inclusive. Generous pacing. 「大々的に」 delivered with quiet confidence — this is a significant effort. The final gratitude feels personal despite the formal frame.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察関係者各位、新年のご挨拶、社長から、お送りする予定です、本当に、お世話に、なっておりますので、心からの感謝、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Our president will be sending New Year's greetings to all our police partners. We truly appreciate the care you've shown us, and we're grateful from the bottom of our hearts.
lines.style: Sincere and closing. Slightly softer than previous lines — moving toward farewell. 「心からの感謝」 is spoken with genuine warmth. Not rushed. The finality of gratitude.
